name: # order block 900-971 = Captain's Quarters; next mod: start a fresh block at 1000 (vanilla itself stays <=500)
Standard Berth Pad
desc: A regulation sleep pad, vacuum-rated and sized to any standard berth frame. Ko Combine produces a million of them per cycle.

name: Domain Ease-Field Berth
desc: A Domain-era berth that floats the sleeper in a weak agrav field. It still runs on its original power cell.

name: Recruitment Print
desc: A Hegemony Navy recruitment print, one sheet from a press run of ten million.

name: XIV Battlegroup Pennant
desc: An honor pennant of the Fourteenth Battlegroup, hand-stitched in wool and gold thread. More verified originals are in circulation than the Battlegroup ever issued.

name: Grav-Cat
desc: Spacers say a cat aboard is good luck. This one is a long-bodied spacer breed, used to zero-g, and it hunts the vermin that come aboard with the cargo.

name: Salvage Raven
desc: A raven of modified Old Earth stock, bred by belt salvors to pick out intact metal. During debris sweeps it perches on the sensor board and taps the glass at promising returns.

name: Hydroponic Herb Rack
desc: A hydroponic rack of galley herbs under a grow strip, plumbed into the ship's water recycler.

name: Eventide Rose Bonsai
desc: Eventide's table-strain dwarf roses were bred for aristo households, and they are particular about light, water, and gravity. Aboard a ship the rose needs attention every day.

name: TriPad Dock
desc: A desk dock for the standard TriPad, with a filing service that sorts incoming messages.

name: Domain Survey Cache
desc: A sealed case of data-slates from the Domain Mineral Exploration Authority, with its survey protocols and calibration tables. The office that issued them is two centuries gone.

name: Scrap Medal Rack
desc: There is a steady salvage-market trade in campaign medals from navies nobody except historians recognize. This rack came as a single lot. The ribbon has faded, but the brass takes a polish.

name: Remnant Facet
desc: A shard of inert glass recovered from a Remnant hull, its faces cut along refracting planes. Assay rates it stable and modestly valuable.

name: Woven Deck Mat
desc: Woven mats of ship-grade fiber are standard issue in most of the Sector's navies. This one gives boots a grip on smooth plating and rolls up for inspection.

name: Kumari Silk Rug
desc: A silk rug from the habitat looms of Kumari Kandam, laid over a conductive backing that drains static charge into the deck. It was requisitioned as morale equipment.

name: Votive Lume-Candles
desc: Electric candles in devotional glass, wired into the cabin's emergency bus so they stay lit through a power loss.

name: Remnant Lumen Shard
desc: A faintly active crystal shard pulled from a Remnant wreck. It flickers in time with the ship's sensor sweeps and brightens when a contact is in range.

name: Caff Urn
desc: A pressure-brewing caff urn of yard-grade steel, dented and relined twice. It served on two ships before this one.

name: Faction Drinks Cabinet
desc: A wall cabinet stocked one port at a time: Hegemony Navy rum, communion wine out of Gilead, and a Tri-Tachyon product labeled as whiskey.

name: Dockside Songbook Chips
desc: Dockside songbooks collect the songs of the Sector's port bars. This case of chips indexes them by system and year.

name: Wardroom Strategikon
desc: A Domain officer-training console with most of its scenario library intact. Instructors still set its maneuver problems as exercises.

name: Gel-Rest Mattress
desc: A mattress of medical gel in a wipe-clean sleeve, the kind station med-bays use in their recovery wards. It keeps a sleeper level when the ship changes burn.

name: Officer's Rest Rack
desc: Prize crews strip an officer's rest rack first when a ship is taken, so few reach the open market. This one is Hegemony pattern, a fold-down frame with regulation bedding.

name: Cryofoam Bunk
desc: Cryosleeper foam is rated to hold a colonist through a century of transit. This bunk was built up from a sleeper ship's spare stock, and it measures the occupant's pulse and cools or warms to match.

name: Stations of the Path Triptych
desc: A folding triptych printed on tin, showing the twelve Stations of the Path.

name: Kill-Mark Stencils
desc: A stencil sheet recovered from a warlord's flagship, kill marks cut in a dozen hull-paint sizes, half of them showing no paint wear at all. The marks that were used correspond to confirmed losses in three systems.

name: Captured Warlord Banner
desc: The personal banner of a warlord, taken in a boarding action and hung with the burn holes unrepaired. Its former owner is alive, at large, and offering a reward for its return well above what any broker would pay.

name: Hull-Rat Cage
desc: A wire cage for a hull-rat that came aboard off a wreck and stayed. The rat finds slow leaks before the sensors flag them, then sits by the spot until someone comes to look.

name: Cyber-Parrot
desc: A parrot with a vocal implant, sold dockside as a novelty. It repeats damage-control calls exactly, and a few times it made the call minutes before the crew did.

name: Agravifish Bowl
desc: A sealed bowl of agravifish from the habitats of Kumari Kandam. The fish glow faintly and swim in slow schools.

name: Antixenol Planter
desc: Antixenol cuttings from Jangala stock, grown under a red lamp. Steeped in hot water, the leaves make the standard frontier remedy for xeno-allergen exposure.

name: Gilead Prayer Garden
desc: A boxed plot of true Gilead soil under glass, planted with barley and a row of kitchen greens.

name: Volturn Reef Terrarium
desc: A sealed section of living reef from the shallows of Volturn, polyps and weed cycling their own water.

name: Secondhand Chart Table
desc: A secondhand chart table with its previous owners' working routes scribed into the surface.

name: Navigator's Ephemeris
desc: A printed slipstream ephemeris carried through two decades of frontier runs, its margins filled with corrections and cautions in several hands.

name: Surveyor's Slate Rack
desc: A rack of Explorarium field slates, loaded with the checklists Domain survey crews worked from.

name: Academy Sample Case
desc: A glass case of xeno-geology reference samples, each labeled with its grade and origin. It is on loan from the Galatia Academy, which has never asked for it back.

name: Vambrace Fragment
desc: An armor fragment from an Onslaught Mk.I, cut from the section the yard manuals call the vambrace. It has no embedded fabrication-rights.

name: Warlord's Sidearm
desc: An engraved sidearm surrendered when a boarding action went against its owner, and never returned. The engraving records victories in ancient script. The mechanism is a common Hegemony pattern, well kept, and shoots true.

name: Insulfiber Carpet
desc: An insulfiber carpet, seamed together from yard surplus and cut to the cabin's deck plan. It deadens footsteps and slows heat loss through the deck plating.

name: Tarsus Deck-Quilt
desc: A deck-quilt stitched from liner blankets by the prize crew of a Tarsus freighter. The layered fill blocks sound and heat.

name: Askonian Ash-Silk Rug
desc: Askonian ash-silk is woven at Sindria from Volturn ash-weed fiber. It takes dye poorly and wears for decades, so most rugs keep the gray of the raw thread.

name: Low-Band Glowpanel
desc: This glowpanel was rewired by a dockside shop to run below its rated output. It gives enough light to work by and draws less power from the bus.

name: Fabrique Orbitale Desk Lamp
desc: A desk lamp built around a sealed micro-fusion core, by the maker of the orbital fusion lamp. The plate on the base reads "Safe for indoor use."

name: Hegemony Signal Lamp
desc: A brass-housed Hegemony signal lamp of the pattern issued to training commands, with its drill sequences still loaded.

name: Prize-Crew Still
desc: A compact still of prize-crew manufacture, producing a spirit that is rough but clean. Incidents involving stripped solvent have stopped since it came aboard. It is plumbed in behind the galley recycler, out of the usual inspection path, not that it matters to you.

name: Volturnian Lobster Tank
desc: Live Volturnian lobster, in a tank plumbed and filtered to holding-pen standards. The flavor is said to be exceptional.

name: Phaged Darjeeling Service
desc: Phase-aged tea is Old Earth leaf carried through phase space until the tannins soften. This service was built for it, with a shielded caddy and a certificate listing every transit.

name: Arms-Catalog Subscription
desc: A subscription to the Sector's arms catalogs, kept on a set of worn TriPads and updated at every port with a comm relay.

name: Holo-Chess Set
desc: A tournament-grade holo-chess set, kept in the wardroom for officers off watch.

name: Muse Cabinet
desc: A Domain-era muse cabinet that composes training scenarios to suit whoever sits at it. The maker's plate certifies that it is a weighted heuristic network and not an AI.

name: Lion's Guard Ceremonial Saber
desc: A ceremonial saber of the Lion's Guard. The blade was never sharpened and the scabbard is welded shut, both per Guard custom for peacetime awards.

name: Motes in Amber
desc: A block of amber resin holding a swarm of motes recovered after the Ziggurat action. The motes still keep formation.

name: Janus Prototype Casing
desc: The housing of a Janus Device prototype, decommissioned and signed out of the Galatia Academy. The active components were removed before transfer.

name: Pilgrim's Twelve-Station Icon
desc: A twelve-panel devotional icon on sanctified tin, carried the length of the Pilgrim's Path and stamped at every shrine along the way. The frame is scrap iron, in keeping with pilgrim practice.

name: Bornanew Reliquary
desc: A reliquary from Jethro Bornanew's mission, sealed in wax and lead by the Ecumene Council.

name: Rao Ball Invitation, Framed
desc: A gilt-edged invitation to the seasonal ball of House Rao on Eventide, framed under glass. It was never declined or withdrawn, so by Eventide etiquette it still stands.

name: Inert Trigger Assembly
desc: The trigger assembly of a planetkiller weapon, kept behind glass. Two separate ordnance boards have certified it inert.

name: Kallichore Reading-Room Plate
desc: A brass reading-room plate from the Kallichore Archive, engraved with the word SILENCE in four dead languages.

name: Kanta's Marker
desc: Kanta's protection is a physical marker, issued from her Den. Pirate crews check for one before they bother with a transponder.

name: Red Planet Survey Slab
desc: A polished core-sample slab from the shield laboratory on the Red Planet, with field notes on depth and composition etched into its face.

name: Imperial Megalobster Tank
desc: A Volturnian megalobster in a pressurized brine tank, surplus from the Diktat's aquaculture program. The line is bred for banquet size, and this one is years short of it.

name: Chicomoztoc Parade Standard
desc: A machine-embroidered Hegemony parade standard from the muster fields of Chicomoztoc, sized for a parade ground rather than a cabin.

name: Kazeron Gens Signet Case
desc: A velvet-lined case of five signets from the great gens of Kazeron. The rings are genuine gold.

name: Eochu Bres Neural Soother
desc: A Tri-Tachyon executive neural soother from Eochu Bres, licensed per user per cycle. The billing stopped when it left the corporate network, and the hardware runs as built.

name: Gilead Reliquary Lamp
desc: A reliquary lamp of consecrated glass from Gilead, blessed for shipboard vigils. The element is shrouded so the light falls soft and carries no distance, which suits the devout at prayer.

name: Tesseract Facet Cluster
desc: A cluster of facets cut from a destroyed Tesseract, mounted in a containment frame.

name: Mothership Chart Core
desc: The navigation chart core of a Domain Explorarium mothership, decades of survey flight in a housing the size of a footlocker. Most frontier charts in circulation are copies of copies of cores like this. This one is an original, and its full index waits on a Domain clearance.

name: Nexus Command Shard
desc: A command shard cut from the heart of a Remnant nexus, still running a closed loop of its old logistics doctrine. Wired into the wardroom game table, it plays a patient, exact positional game. It has also taken to adding items to the maintenance schedule.

name: Lab Sample Carousel
desc: A motorized sample carousel from a research station, turning its tubes through a preservation schedule.

name: Quartermaster's Lockbox
desc: A quartermaster's lockbox from a military equipment cache, rated against blast, vacuum, and forced entry. The manifest form is blank.

name: Core-Sample Bookends
desc: A pair of bookends cut from polished drill-core slugs, out of a mining station's assay office.

name: Hab-Grown Vine Basket
desc: Edible vine from an orbital habitat's air garden, rooted in filter sponge in a woven basket. It feeds on scrubber exhaust and gives a handful of greens each week.
